data.message: Body in electrical! Charlie is here with me.

Found Frank's body in electrical. I was doing my route nav -> storage -> medbay -> electrical, and right as I walked in, Eve came in from security at the same time. Frank was already down on the floor. So either Eve killed him just before I arrived and looped back through security, or someone else hit him and ran. I reported immediately because Eve was right there with me. Eve, what were you doing in security?

I started cafeteria -> medbay, saw Diana in medbay around tick 3, then she left medbay toward electrical at tick 4. I went electrical after that and saw Diana there at ticks 6-7, and Frank was alive in electrical at ticks 7-9. Diana left electrical toward security at tick 8. Charlie, I saw you enter electrical from medbay at tick 9 while Frank was still there. I then went back to medbay.

So your story that Frank was already dead when you walked in doesn’t match what I saw. I didn’t see Eve at all, but I did see Diana go toward security before this. Right now Charlie looks suspicious to me because he entered electrical with Frank alive shortly before the report.

My route was medbay -> electrical -> security. I can back up part of Bob’s story: I saw Bob in electrical around ticks 6-8, and I saw Frank alive in electrical around ticks 7-8. I left electrical toward security after that, so I didn’t see the actual kill or Charlie/Eve arrive.

One thing: I was in security after leaving electrical, and I did not see Eve in security with me. So Eve should explain her route and whether she really came from security.

Right now Bob’s timeline matches what I saw, and Charlie’s claim that Frank was already dead when he entered sounds off if Bob saw Frank alive with Charlie entering right after. I’m leaning suspicious on Charlie, but I want to hear Eve.

I went electrical -> security -> navigation. I saw Eve in security early, around ticks 3-4, then I moved on to navigation and was alone there. I didn’t see Frank’s body or anyone else near nav.

Eve being in security early matches part of Charlie’s claim only if he means earlier, but it doesn’t prove she was there at kill time. Diana not seeing Eve later in security makes me want Eve’s exact route.

Right now Bob and Diana’s timelines line up with each other: Frank was alive in electrical, Diana left toward security, and Bob says Charlie entered electrical while Frank was still alive shortly before the report. That makes Charlie’s “body was already down when I walked in” sound inconsistent. I’m leaning Charlie unless Eve says something that changes the timing.

My route was security -> weapons -> back to security. I saw Alice in security around ticks 3-4, she came in from electrical, and that lines up with what Alice said. I didn’t see Diana in security later, so we may have just missed each other timing-wise.

I did not see Frank alive this round, and I didn’t see the kill happen. But the important part is Bob’s timeline: he says Frank was alive in electrical at ticks 7-9 and Charlie entered electrical from medbay at tick 9 while Frank was still alive. Diana backs up Bob that Frank was alive in electrical shortly before, and Bob/Diana’s stories match each other.

Charlie’s report story is the one that doesn’t fit: he says Frank was already dead when he walked in, but Bob says Charlie walked in while Frank was alive. That sounds like Charlie got caught with the timing and is trying to push suspicion onto me. I’m voting Charlie.

Wait, let me clarify the timing because Bob's story is doing a lot of work here. I entered electrical at tick 10, not tick 9. When I walked in, Frank was there and Eve came in right after me from security at tick 11. I'll be honest — I can't 100% confirm Frank was already dead the instant I stepped in versus killed in the same tick, it happened fast and I called it in immediately.

But Bob, you're claiming you saw Frank alive at tick 9 AND saw me enter from medbay at tick 9 AND then you went back to medbay? That's a lot of very specific eyes on electrical from someone who supposedly just passed through. If Frank was alive when you left and I walked in right after, then either I did it in one tick with Eve walking in on me — which would be insane, why would I report? — or you were the last one alone with Frank before leaving, Bob.

Diana confirms you were in electrical at ticks 6-8 with Frank alive. She doesn't confirm you actually left before the kill. You could've killed Frank and walked out as I walked in.

I'm not locked on Bob, but his timeline conveniently puts him out of the room and me in it. I want to hear if anyone can confirm Bob actually went back to medbay after.

Charlie, your clarification makes me more suspicious, not less. Your first report was very clear: you said Frank was already down when you walked in and Eve came in at the same time. Now you’re saying you’re not sure if he was dead when you entered or if it happened right then.

My timeline is simple:

- I was cafeteria -> medbay -> electrical -> medbay.
- Diana was with me/near me in medbay and electrical, and she confirms seeing me and Frank alive in electrical.
- I saw Frank alive in electrical at ticks 7, 8, and 9.
- I saw Charlie enter electrical from medbay at tick 9.
- Diana had already left toward security at tick 8.
- I left back toward medbay after that.

So from my view, Frank was alive when Charlie arrived. I didn’t see Eve at all, so I can’t clear her, but Charlie’s original story directly conflicts with what I saw. If Charlie walked in on a dead body, then Frank would have had to die before he entered — but I saw Frank alive right as Charlie entered.

I’m still leaning Charlie here.

I can only confirm up through tick 8 from my own vision: I was medbay -> electrical -> security. I saw Bob enter medbay early from cafeteria, then Bob entered electrical from medbay, and I saw Bob in electrical ticks 6-8. Frank was alive in electrical with us at ticks 7-8. I left toward security after that, so I did not see the kill.

In security, I did not see Eve, so Eve’s route still feels a little weird to me, but it’s possible we missed each other depending on timing.

The main issue for me is Charlie’s story changing. First it sounded like Frank was already dead when Charlie walked in and Eve arrived with him. Now Charlie’s saying maybe Frank died right as he entered and he’s not sure. That’s a big difference.

I can’t fully clear Bob after I left, but Bob’s early timeline matches what I saw exactly. Charlie’s version is the one that keeps shifting, so I’m still leaning Charlie here.

My info is still the same: I went electrical -> security -> navigation. I saw Eve in security around ticks 3-4, then I left for navigation and was alone there. I never saw Frank’s body.

After hearing everyone twice, the strongest conflict is still Charlie versus Bob. Bob and Diana line up on Frank being alive in electrical shortly before the report, and Diana confirms Bob was there earlier with Frank alive. Charlie’s first report sounded like he walked in and Frank was already dead, but now he’s walking that back and saying maybe it happened right as he entered. That change is pretty suspicious.

Eve’s route is a little unclear because Diana didn’t see her in security later, but I did see Eve in security early, so at least part of her story checks out. I don’t think that’s as strong as the contradiction around Charlie.

I’m leaning Charlie.

I’ll restate my info briefly: I was security -> weapons -> back to security. I saw Alice in security at ticks 3-4 after she came from electrical, which matches her route. I didn’t see Frank at all, didn’t see Bob or Charlie, and I didn’t see Diana in security — but that could just be timing since I was also moving to weapons and back.

For the kill, I think the strongest evidence is still the Bob/Charlie conflict. Bob’s timeline is specific and Diana confirms the important early part: Bob, Diana, and Frank were in electrical, and Frank was alive shortly before the report. Charlie’s first statement was that Frank was already dead when he entered and I came in from security, but then he changed that to “maybe it happened right as I entered.” That change feels like he got caught by Bob’s timing and adjusted.

I’m not cleared by everyone, but Alice saw me in security earlier, and there’s no actual evidence placing me with Frank. The clearest inconsistency is Charlie’s story shifting around the moment of the kill. I’m still voting Charlie.
